metadata.body:
# PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

Blueprint for clio-agent. The numeric work lives in plain scripts in this
repository so it can run on PBS compute nodes without an LLM:

- `agent/manifest.py`: list the DASV records on `s3://nrel-pds-porotomo/` and sample them.
- `agent/detect.py`: per-record detector (common-mode removal, 10-150 Hz band-pass, median STA/LTA).
- `agent/pbs/submit.sh`: submit the distributed detection plus aggregation job to Aurora.
- `agent/hazard.py`: anomaly z-scores, event catalogue, pumping volumes, seismogenic index, probabilities.

The experts orchestrate those scripts, inspect files, and explain results. They
never make up numbers. Every figure they report comes from `summary.json` or a
tool result.

Install by linking this directory into `~/.config/clio-agent/agent-blueprints/`.

agent_blueprint.name: PoroTomo Induced-Seismicity Agent

COUNTS
- Records analysed: 759 (by_status.ok: 759; stride 20; first "2016-03-18T02:09:17Z", last "2016-03-26T00:59:44Z"; sampled_fraction_of_time 0.033141355084075994; mean_ms_per_record 2003.9857707509884)
- Anomalous records: 57 (z_threshold 5.0; top anomaly "2016-03-23T20:50:17Z" zmax 30.92 driver "max_sta_lta")
- Detections: 62 (das_events.n = 62; events.csv has 63 lines = 1 header + 62 data rows; header: time,key,t_s,dur_s,peak_ratio,peak_amp,median_ch_amp,frac_channels,first_depth,mrel; n_scaled_to_full_time 1870.774440052701; records_with_events 53; b_relative 0.9849352475487246; mc_relative -0.8492463451632817; n_above_mc 34)

SEISMOGENIC INDEX Sigma AND P(Mw>=5.5) PER YEAR — CALIBRATED CATALOGUE-BASED MODEL (hazard_catalog_based; source "GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016", n=5, mc=-0.48, mag_max 0.07, calibrated ML). These are the CALIBRATED probabilities (p_per_year_at_observed_rate "M>=5.5"), quoted exactly:
- b=1.0: sigma = -5.448901270028832 ; P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.00011982478978644906
- b=0.73: sigma = -5.3193012700288325 ; P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.004921548824626587
- b=0.65: sigma = -5.280901270028833 ; P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.014735103451029574

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (hazard_das_upper_bound) — UNCALIBRATED, an UPPER BOUND that over-counts:
- b_used 0.9849352475487246 (b_source "DAS relative-magnitude Aki MLE"); sigma = -2.698279919032152
- P(Mw>=5.5)/yr at observed rate = 0.07842182774171746
- This value treats every DAS detection as an event at or above the catalogue minimum magnitude (mc_relative -0.8492463451632817) and uses uncalibrated relative magnitudes (mrel), not calibrated ML, so it is a DAS-based upper bound, not a calibrated estimate.

WHICH IS WHICH: the catalogue-based (LBNL/NCEDC GDR 859, calibrated ML) per-b probabilities above are the CALIBRATED values; the 0.07842182774171746 figure is the DAS-based UPPER BOUND with uncalibrated magnitudes.

ASSUMPTIONS recorded in the files: model Shapiro et al. (2021) Eq. 5, P = 1 - exp(-V 10^(Sigma - b M)); catalog from GDR 859 LBNL/NCEDC March 2016 (calibrated ML, n=5, mc=-0.48, mag_max=0.07); pumping from GDR 917 corrected deployment data (days 15.958333333333334, injected_m3 465448.11344981275, extracted_m3 505933.04934013565, net_injected_m3 -40484.9358903229, window 2016-03-11T08:00:00+00:00 to 2016-03-27T07:00:00+00:00); correlations_hourly: spearman_events_vs_net_injection -0.1727533876579381, spearman_events_vs_abs_change_in_net -0.02964200695843252, spearman_events_vs_injection -0.09264557773301593; pohang reference: sigma_range [-2.0,-1.0], b_values [0.65,0.73], mainshock_mw 5.5, worst_case_probability_reported [0.15,0.17], v_fig3c_m3 5850.0.
